title: Santa's Favorite Dinker Sweatshirt, Vintage Pickleball Christmas Crewneck, Funny Pickleball Gift for Mom or Dad
description:
Officially on the nice list. A vintage-badge pickleball sweatshirt for the player who never misses a dink.

Who it's for:
- Moms, dads and grandparents who play every morning
- Christmas, Secret Santa and stocking-stuffer shoppers
- Club holiday parties and gift exchanges

About the design:
A round vintage badge: a winking cartoon pickleball in a Santa hat with a paddle, a red 'DINKER' ribbon, 'Santa's Favorite' arched across the top and 'Official Nice List' below. Screen-print style colours with a subtle worn texture.

Soft, cozy unisex crewneck sweatshirt. Size up for an oversized fit.

This design was created by our shop with the help of AI design tools and is printed on demand by our production partner.
alt_text: Maroon crewneck sweatshirt with a vintage round badge of a winking pickleball in a Santa hat and a ribbon reading Santa's Favorite Dinker.
